bumpRationale: Security hardening (2026-07-03): server-authoritative maker-checker for UserProfile.app_role changes. New Base44 backend function governRoleChange enforces role-change requests and approvals with the service role, closing the client-side-only enforcement of findings C1 (self/cross-elevation to ADMIN) and C2 (self-approval of a PendingChange) for the app UI. PermisosRoles now routes every role request and approval through the function; shared rules live in src/lib/authorization/roleGovernance.js and are unit-tested. Full raw-SDK closure additionally requires a per-field RLS lock on app_role plus onboarding rerouting, staged for owner deploy — see docs/security-role-governance-remediation.md. All 263 tests pass; lint clean; RLS validation green (31 entities); release gate green (23/23).

architecture.runtime: browser (client-side only; no application server) + Base44 backend functions for privileged mutations
architecture.enforcementBoundary: base44 Row-Level Security (RLS) in base44/entities/*.jsonc + service-role backend functions in base44/functions/*
architecture.language: JavaScript / JSX (type-checked via jsconfig); Deno TypeScript for backend functions

assistantSkills.note: The sibling claude-skills repo holds 48 generic Anthropic/Claude authoring skills (pdf, xlsx, brainstorming, math-olympiad, ...). They are assistant tooling used to BUILD Liuma — NOT features of the application, not integrated into it, and not listed in the user manual.
